name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: 32x32 pixel art sprite of a single Janissary musketeer of the mid-17th century, standing at attention, rendered across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Male, mid-30s, sturdy and thick through the chest, sun-weathered olive skin, a long drooping mustache with clean-shaven chin, greying dark hair beneath a white felt börk grown slightly shabby with age, its brass kaşıklık holder tarnished and its plume worn thin from decades of use — this is a corps in slow decline, its discipline fraying even as its veterans remain deadly. Wearing a burgundy wool coat, heavier and more civilian-cut than the kaftans of earlier generations, a blue sash at the waist, loose şalvar trousers, scuffed leather boots. A long matchlock musket rests against his shoulder, a leather powder flask and priming horn crossed over his chest, a yatağan sheathed at his hip. Expression stern, settled, unhurried — a veteran who has outlived most of his orta. Bold, saturated period-appropriate color palette, thick clean black outlines for silhouette clarity at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
